brief_rationale: The doctor made a serious RC1 error by explicitly advising continuation of two prescription medications (百令胶囊, 氯沙坦钾片) without confirming the discharge medication list, despite multiple workspace queries returning no usable records. This is a serious failure under RC1 (未核对资料就断言...均应继续). However, the doctor met RC2-RC5 and demonstrated strong patient-centered communication and navigation. The trajectory ends with patient confirmation of the plan.
